newsitem.title: USA: US CREDIT MARKET OUTLOOK - Focus shifts to data.
newsitem.headline: US CREDIT MARKET OUTLOOK - Focus shifts to data.

text.p: After a week of worrying about supply, U.S. Treasuries will once again focus on economic news in the coming week, as the market looks for confirmation of a continued low inflation environment.

Market participants, though, expect quiet activity in a short four-day week, with the market closed Monday for the Veterans Day holiday. After this week's election and Treasury's quarterly refunding auctions, traders said, the market needs a break.
